street.note: 60' R/W and 26' pavement per the approved Joseph Drive section (Yocum Property, DPIE 15927-2020-0). utilities.note: Water and sewer for every lot are served from WAHALLA COURT. The subdivision's mains connect to the existing WSSC mains in WHEELER at the entrance and extend the length of WAHALLA COURT to the cul-de-sac. WSSC as-built size and location of the mains in WHEELER, and the sewer's depth and flow direction, are not read here and govern the connection.

street.radiusCaveat: 100-ft centreline radius and a 15° skew at the Wheeler intersection (75° angle) — both within what a local street is usually allowed; confirm with DPW&T before preliminary plan.

stormwater.method: MDE Stormwater Design Manual Ch. 5 ESD: Rv = 0.05 + 0.009·I; ESDv = P_E·Rv·A/12; practice = ESDv/(d·n)

parcelA.where: low west corner, elevations 132–188 ft NAVD88 (PGAtlas 2-ft contours)

perLot: 6-ft infiltration berm along the rear lot line (2023 sheet legend)
stormwater.caveat: P_E = 1.0 in is the Manual's floor; Table 5.3 sets it by % impervious and HSG (SSURGO: B/D, C, D). Infiltration feasibility depends on the Sec. 32-131 soils investigation. DPIE concept approval precedes preliminary plan.

result.whyNotTheCap: With the curve capped at 135 ft and one entrance, a spine down the tract serves two tiers of lots 75 ft wide; the tract is 400 ft deep so the lots run 10–16k sf and 13 is what 814 searched geometries fit (v3's L-shaped street fit 14 with a 176-ft bend). The 2023 sheet's 19 needed a loop street and an alley.
